# S3TestTask

Tech Stack

Elixir — functional programming language for building scalable applications
Phoenix Framework — web framework with LiveView for real-time UI
AWS S3 — cloud object storage for CSV file uploads
AWS Redshift — cloud data warehouse for ETL processing and star schema analytics

Overview
A dimensional star schema designed for analyzing UK road traffic collisions (2017–2022). Built on AWS Redshift, the warehouse transforms raw CSV data from the UK Department for Transport into an optimized analytical model with 3 fact tables, 10 dimension tables, and 1 lookup table.
